admission.justification: Defines cross-seat launch knob precedence for consolidation-pass independent review and is guarded by consolidation settings-row unit tests.

applicability: Role launch settings resolution for a Reviewer seat on a consolidation leaf.
conditions: orchestration.roles.consolidation-reviewer overlays orchestration.roles.reviewer field by field whenever the task document carries consolidationList, regardless of start order.
Explicit per-start caller overrides take precedence over both settings rows, and absent or empty consolidation-reviewer falls back to reviewer.
exclusions: Ordinary leaves without consolidationList, whose Reviewer reads only orchestration.roles.reviewer.

evidence: test_consolidator_role.py (variant row precedence, fallback, explicit override, reviewer-before-consolidator) and sbx-e8 Evidence 8 live run (consolidation-reviewer antigravity-acp/gemini-4-neon-high took precedence over reviewer hermes/deepseek-v4.1-flash).

statement: Settings key orchestration.roles.consolidation-reviewer overrides orchestration.roles.reviewer field by field for a consolidation leaf's Reviewer (whether started before or alongside the Consolidator) while preserving explicit start overrides and falling back to reviewer when absent.
title: consolidation-reviewer settings overlay for consolidation leaf Reviewer
